name: Mike Finnegan
role: Medora "bad man" convicted of stealing Roosevelt's Elkhorn boat
bio: Mike Finnegan, whom the Cow Boy mocked as "Mr. Bad Man Finnegan," was disarmed by Fred Willard in December 1885 after a drunken display with a rifle, and in April 1886 was accused of stealing a row-boat from the Elkhorn ranch of Theodore Roosevelt, the future president, then a Bad Lands rancher. Brought back, sent to Mandan for trial, he and a partner pleaded guilty to grand larceny in August 1886 and were each sentenced to twenty-five months; in November the paper reported him in the Bismarck penitentiary.
